subject: CAIQ control mapping & evidence orchestration for Acme Health assessment
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T14:22:00Z
Subject: CAIQ request: control mapping and sample artifacts

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for agreeing to run the Acme Health CAIQ review with us. Our audit team is starting to pull together the cloud controls assessment and we need a control crosswalk and a short bundle of artifacts to validate a handful of runtime and key management controls. Specifically can you provide:

- A CAIQ crosswalk that maps Redwood controls to CSA sections (just the controls we scope to the service layer)
- A short runtime log sample showing request/response headers for a developer API call (sanitized is fine)
- The KMS key rotation and access policy PDF or pointer to the artifact
- Any statements on model isolation and data-retention defaults we can attach

We'd like to get the first pass by EOD Thursday (2027-05-13) to keep the timeline. If there are any controls you're not comfortable sharing, note that and we can mark them for remote review.

Appreciate the help — please CC security@acmehealth.com on the response.

Best,
Tom Ellis
Director, Security Assurance
Acme Health

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T15:05:00Z
Subject: Re: CAIQ request: control mapping and sample artifacts

Tom — thanks for the clear ask. Outline below is how we'll deliver and what we need from you:  

Plan (deliverables + owners):
- CAIQ crosswalk (spreadsheet) that maps our internal control IDs to the CSA questions — owner: Marissa Cole. Deliverable: redwood_caiq_crosswalk_v1.xlsx
- Runtime log sample (sanitized) showing trace IDs and token-less headers — owner: Ben Carter. Deliverable: runtime_log_sample.txt
- KMS/key rotation policy excerpt + pointer to full policy in our vault — owner: Marissa. Deliverable: kms_rotation_policy.pdf + vault link
- Short narrative on model isolation/data retention defaults (2 paragraphs) — owner: Hannah

How we’ll share:
- We'll stage a zipped evidence bundle in a shared Drive folder and share the link once artifacts are assembled. If you need a transfer method other than Drive, tell us.

Permissions we need from Acme:
- Confirmation that the sanitized runtime logs can be viewed by Acme security and by our redacted-audit reviewer (one of your third-party auditors).
- If you want source IP ranges masked or any further redactions, say so now.

Timing: we'll aim to get the crosswalk + two artifacts to you by EOD Wednesday (2027-05-12). If anything slips we'll flag immediately.

Marissa — can you accept the crosswalk and KMS bits? Ben — can you pull a 1-hour window runtime sample and sanitize per our internal log guidelines?

Onward,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of GRC Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T09:43:00Z
Subject: Re: CAIQ request: control mapping and sample artifacts

Hi all — attaching the first pass artifacts and callouts. See attached file list below — these are sanitized versions intended for the assessment window.  

Attachment stubs: 
- redwood_caiq_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (CAIQ mapping for scoped service controls; column H notes evidence source)
- runtime_log_sample.txt (1-hour sample, UUIDs replaced, token fields removed; includes request IDs and timing breakdowns)
- kms_rotation_policy.pdf (excerpts from our rotation policy; full policy is in the vault linked in the crosswalk)

Notes/footnotes: 
- For controls related to token handling and retention, we highlighted the default retention period (30 days) and the location of the archival policy.
- Model isolation: We included the service-level statement (see row 23 in the spreadsheet) and a short appendix describing tenant isolation in the runtime.
- Controls we flagged as "sensitive": KMS master key material procedures and some production debug logs. For those, we propose a live remote review rather than sharing full artifacts.

Ben — confirmed you sanitized the logs per policy GRC-LOG-07; I included the sanitization checklist in the Drive folder.

Tom — letting you know these are available in the shared Drive link (Drive link included below). If you prefer a password-protected bundle, we can produce a zip and a separate transfer.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFGhijk-Evidence-ACME-2027

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

On Mon, May 10, 2027 at 15:05 Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmehealth.com>, security@acmehealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T17:03:00Z
Subject: Final evidence bundle: CAIQ crosswalk + artifacts (Acme Health)

Tom / Acme security team —

Per the plan, we've packaged the artifacts and a short narrative. The bundle contains:  
- redwood_caiq_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (CAIQ mapping, evidence pointers, owner notes)
- runtime_log_sample.txt (sanitized sample)
- kms_rotation_policy.pdf (excerpts)
- evidence-bundle-20270512.zip (password-protected archive available on request)

Access: the files are staged at the Drive link below. For any "sensitive" items we flagged in the crosswalk, we are prepared to do a live remote review with screen share and joint validation. To proceed we need confirmation that:  
1) The Drive link is acceptable for initial review (if not, we will provide a secure transfer).
2) You confirm the identities/emails of the reviewers who will access the files so we can grant read-only permissions.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFGhijk-Evidence-ACME-2027

If everything looks good, we'll close this evidence sprint in our tracker and update the CAIQ spreadsheet with the final reviewer notes.

Thanks for the coordinated effort.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of GRC Programs
Redwood Inference
